description: "Called by customer-ordering to compensate a checkout whose later group failed to confirm: the promises already CONFIRMED are cancelled so their capacity is given back. No request body. A CONFIRMED or AT_RISK promise becomes CANCELLED (cancelReason CANCELLED_ON_REQUEST), the confirmed hold goes back to its PromiseBook and PromiseCancelled goes to the analytics topic, in one transaction. Idempotent: cancelling an already CANCELLED promise is a no-op returning 200 with the same view. A PROVISIONAL, KEPT, BROKEN or RELEASED promise is refused with illegal-transition (409); a provisional hold is never cancelled, it lapses by itself (ReleaseExpiredHolds)."

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/promises/{promiseId}:cancel"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Called by customer-ordering to compensate a checkout whose later group failed to confirm: the promises already CONFIRMED are cancelled so their capacity is given back. No request body. A CONFIRMED or AT_RISK promise becomes CANCELLED (cancelReason CANCELLED_ON_REQUEST), the confirmed hold goes back to its PromiseBook and PromiseCancelled goes to the analytics topic, in one transaction. Idempotent: cancelling an already CANCELLED promise is a no-op returning 200 with the same view. A PROVISIONAL, KEPT, BROKEN or RELEASED promise is refused with illegal-transition (409); a provisional hold is never cancelled, it lapses by itself (ReleaseExpiredHolds).
